lateral_flank_blob_constellation.centroid_triangulation: A series of high-luminance circular clusters arranged in roughly parallel horizontal rows posterior to the gill slits. The arrangement follows a grid-like distribution with spacing increasing slightly towards the posterior.
lateral_flank_blob_constellation.stripe_intersections: Clearly defined vertical bands of elevated pixel intensity intersect the horizontal rows of blobs, creating a structured grid pattern of anchor nodes across the lateral flank.

carinae_gradient_vectors.ridge_trajectory: Three prominent horizontal ridges are visible on the upper flank, characterized by a sharp luminance gradient with high intensity on the superior edge and shadowing on the inferior edge.

other_distinctive_markers: Presence of multiple elongated, lower-luminance silhouettes swimming in close proximity beneath the ventral side of the pectoral fin.
